# (the release's own manifest, dist/channel-rust-1.100.0.toml, names them): the compiler and cargo for the runner
# (x86_64 Linux), and the standard library of the runner and of each target the plugin is built for.  Installed by
# tools/rustpin.sh into a folder of its own, nothing resolved online by a channel or a manifest fetched at build time

# and rust-toolchain.toml's channel raised with them (make release-test holds the two to one version)
